_about: Gamepad -> virtual mouse and keyboard for recording demos (src/zombiesai/demos/gamepad.py). Buttons are the kernel's positional gamepad names (south = Xbox A / Cross, east = B / Circle, west = X / Square, north = Y / Triangle; xpad swaps north and west, check with `uv run python -m zombiesai.demos.gamepad --watch`). Values are the key names configs/waw_bindings.json uses. lt/rt work for analog and digital triggers; left_stick_* are the left stick past move.press.
